::: {#hero-heading}
<div class="h1">Hey, I'm happy you're here</div>

Thanks for stopping by! 

I work as a research assistant at the [NTID Research Center on Culture and Language](https://www.rit.edu/ntid/research-center-culture-and-language) at the Rochester Institute of Technology. My research intrests inlcude utilizing data 
to improve educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students.

My current project with the NTID Research Center on Culture and Language aims to develop standardized assestment tools in American Sign Language to evaulate and screen for Alzheimer's disease and dementia in Deaf and Hard of Hearing Older Adults. Learn more about our work on the [project page](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41642783/). 

Connect with me on[LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/emmamkane).

:::

## About me

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6 #about-me-1}

**Biomedical engineer turned informaticist, curious about all intersections of data and society.**

I enjoy using [R](https://www.r-project.org/about.html) to optimize my data science workflow and have noticed it making guest appearances elsewhere in my life. I'm certified as an [RStudio Tidyverse Instructor](https://education.rstudio.com/trainers/people/canelon+silvia/) and am passionate about R education and data literacy as ways to build power in communities. Explore my [projects](/projects) and [presentations](/presentation).

   <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-certificate"></i></span><a href="https://education.rstudio.com/trainers/people/canelon+silvia/">Tidyverse Instructor Certification</a> ∙ RStudio, PBC ∙ 2020</li>
</ul>

:::

::: {.g-col-6 #about-me-2}

Prior to joining the Urban Health Lab, I developed novel data mining methods to extract meaningful information from the EHR and study health outcomes and disparities in pregnant populations. I'm particularly interested in research that combines biomedical data science with open data sources in ways that prioritize health equity in communities.
